ownership.quote: Gologin came up in 2019 as a new solution for account and login security management. What was once a humble fingerprint and proxy tool, now evolved into a full-scale agency platform thousands rely on daily.

stage.note: No accelerator, venture-round, or investor mentions found on the company site, in press, on Crunchbase (blocked/no listing found), or in general web/HN search. Small antidetect-browser SaaS (Gologin LLC, founded 2019); likely self-funded but no confirming source, so left unknown rather than guessed.

note: GoLogin (Gologin LLC) is an antidetect/cloud browser tool for managing multiple accounts, founded in 2019. It sells directly via self-serve paid plans (from $24/mo per about page) with no evidence of external venture funding, accelerator participation, or acquisition; appears to be a small independent, likely bootstrapped, software company, but this could not be confirmed from public sources within the research window.
